title: Between Faith and Evidence · Why read this book?
description: The book keeps faith, evidence, and doubt in one disciplined conversation.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: What remains when certainty loosens on both sides? This agnostic investigation examines science, religion, and competing claims to certainty. Twenty-five historical dossiers explore beliefs associated with influential thinkers.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: The book keeps faith, evidence, and doubt in one disciplined conversation.
readerInvitation.audienceFit: readers exploring belief, science, uncertainty, and intellectual honesty
readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Read Between Faith and Evidence to follow the complete argument, examples, and consequences.
readerOutcomes: The discussion separates biographical testimony from scientific and philosophical arguments.
Chapters clarify materialism, atheism, agnosticism, and the boundaries of expert authority.
Educational questions connect intellectual history with evidence and responsibility.
